instruction: The method name `render` on `ProgressColumn` (rich/progress.py) is too generic: it is easy to confuse with the many other `render` methods in rich. Rename `ProgressColumn.render` to `render_cell`. The rename must cover the base class, every subclass that overrides it, and every place that calls it, including tests. Do not rename any other `render` method or attribute; they belong to unrelated classes. Behavior must not change: the project must still work and its tests must pass.
